facts.fact: Webb Fontaine says it completed migration of Benin's national Customs Management System from ASYCUDA to Webb Customs, fully operational at all sea ports, airports and land border offices, with over 100,000 declarations processed.

Webb Fontaine says it launched Benin's Guichet Unique du Commerce Extérieur (Single Window) in 2018, and that the government is interconnecting the Single Window, Port Community System, Electronic Cargo Tracking and the Customs Management System.

note: No electronic exchange of declaration data with another country's customs is stated.
